ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.title: Relic Coupons
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.descript: Earn Relic Coupons from Elites and Treasure Chests. Each coupon is paired with an Archipelago Relic item, granting its relic through naturally or via the Archipelago rewards menu.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.flavor: A promise that somewhere in the multiworld, a relic is waiting for you.
